Campspot API, park 3234 (https://www.campspot.com/book/banner-creek-reservoir), read in-browser 2026-11-05 for 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-13: '30 AMP BACK IN' 14 sites (Deer Run, rigs 45-50 ft), '30 AMP PULL THROUGH' 3 (80 ft), '30/50 AMP Deer Run back in' 5 (40-45 ft), '30/50 AMP Water View Cedar Point' 20 (45-55 ft; 'We have 22 sites at Cedar Point located on the north side of the lake, and all of these sites have a water view and are a back in site ... Quote for Cedar Point 2026-11-10: site $20.00 + 'Short Term Booking Fee' $6.00 (the same $6 on a 2-night quote, so per stay), no Campspot fee, no tax. 2027 dates list only Deer Run and shelters (not yet released).

Park map https://www.bannerreservoir.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/2023-Banner-Map.pdf (2023): Campgrounds A, B and C ('Camping with RV Hookups') with Cedar Point at the lake end of C on the north-west shore; 'Camping with Hookups' at the south entrance; RV dump stations at the north and south sides.

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-05 (winter frames: 900 m half at 39.4560,-95.7770; 330 m half at 39.4565,-95.7795; 130 m half at 39.4549,-95.7790; 230 m half at 39.4510,-95.7705): the north-west complex (A/B/C, Deer Run) is loops among trees 100-200 m west of the lake behind a treeline; its south end is an open gravel/grass lot ~20-50 m from the water behind a strip of trees, no pedestals legible. The South Side loop on the south peninsula (~39.4512,-95.7713) has ~18 angled back-in spurs on open grass ~70-100 m from the west shore across the loop road and ~60-100 m from the east cove, scattered trees only.

note: Jackson County reservoir park on K-16 west of Holton, office at 10975 K-16 Hwy. Hook-up loops are Deer Run (A/B/C, same-day only, with the shower house), Cedar Point at the lake end of the north-west loops, the South Side peninsula loop, and the long-term Buffalo Run loop (by phone), which also has primitive sites. Pay daily permits at the courtesy box inside the gate. --Claude
summary: County site + Campspot read: $20 hookup / $13 primitive, $5 daily vehicle entrance, $6 per-stay online booking fee; 86 hookup sites 30/50A + water (79 on Campspot, rigs 40-90 ft), showers, dump. Cedar Point & South Side reservable with a 4-night weekend / 7-night holiday minimum; Deer Run same-day; Buffalo Run long-term by phone. Count 86 written. Operator calls Cedar Point and South Side 'water view' and the South Side loop has an open view ~70-100 m across grass - lakeview upgrade lead.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE LEAD (not waterfront -> lakeview): the operator names two Campspot types '30/50 AMP Water View Cedar Point' (22 sites, 'all of these sites have a water view') and '30/50 AMP Water View South' (18 sites, 'All these sites have a water view'). Imagery of the South Side loop (~39.4512,-95.7713): ~18 angled back-in spurs on open grass ~70-100 m from the west shore across the loop road, ~60-100 m from the east cove, scattered trees only - an open view, but a road and the distance keep it off on-water. Cedar Point couldn't be pinned on the winter imagery (the open lot at the south end of the north-west loops is ~20-50 m from the water behind a tree strip, no pedestals legible). The stored evidence ('RV loops sit on high ground ... behind a 50-100m tree-grass buffer') looked only at the north-west loops.

BOOKING MINIMUM (report, not a standing minimum): advance reservations at Cedar Point and South Side carry a 4-night minimum on weekends and 7 on holidays; weekday nights have none (a one-night Cedar Point Tuesday and Friday in November 2026 both showed AVAILABLE), and Deer Run is same-day with no minimum. Written as min_stay weekend 4 / holiday 7.
LONG-TERM LOOP: Buffalo Run is 'our long term loop' (phone only); the other loops are sold by the night, so this is not a long-stay problem.
Phone 785-364-4236 confirmed (office; north host 785-851-0408, south host 785-851-1153). Stored pin 39.4584,-95.78018 is on the north entrance road by loop B - acceptable.
